title: AI assigns primary circle; users do not browse-join circles
summary: Users do not browse or self-select into circles. AI assigns the primary circle from the voice interview (personality + interests + city). Users may view circle types for education but cannot join by preference alone. Secondary circle selection is AI-suggested and user-confirmed inside circle detail (see secondary-circle-detail-only).
rationale: Operator rejected circle-browsing UX. AI hears the full interview and knows personality fit better than self-selection. Clarified Jul 9: primary is AI-only; secondary is pick-from-AI-suggestions, not free browse.
situation: Agents implemented browse/join and swap semantics inconsistent with placement model.
evidence: Cursor prompt 2026-07-09: placing into circle is not users choice
